- Please include a short statement confirming data residency for log retention related to the controls (where logs are stored and for how long).
- We also need to understand your approach to ephemeral key rotation for inference workloads (summary acceptable, architecture diagram optional).

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-10-23T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarification on artifact channels for SOC2/ISO sections of the RFP

Hi Alice / Jacob — thanks for the quick turnaround. Deliverables and plan below: 

Deliverables (attached / shared):
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf — one-page high-level summary of our SOC 2 scope and auditor opinion (attached).
- redacted_SOC2_TypeII.pdf (shared link in Drive) — redactions limited to customer names and endpoints only per your guidance.
- control-matrix-nexa.xlsx — includes per-control mapping + EvidenceIndex (attached).
- evidence-checklist.csv — CSV manifest for your ingestion pipeline (attached).

Evidence transfer method: we will provision a read-only Drive folder and provide a short-lived signed link for auditors. All artifacts in the folder will follow the naming convention: NEXA-<control id>-<artifact-type>.<ext>. We will also provide MD5 checksums in the EvidenceIndex for integrity verification.

Data residency and retention (summary):
- Logs for production inference workloads are retained in us-west-2 for 90 days by default; telemetry aggregated for trend analysis is retained for 365 days.
- Customers can configure longer retention on Dedicated/Private deployments; we'll note this in the final RFP appendix.

Ephemeral keys & rotation (summary):
- Inference service uses short-lived keys provisioned through our KMS integration with automatic rotation every 24 hours for ephemeral session keys. Root/long-lived keys are stored in customer KMS for Private deployments; for Hosted we use customer-managed KMS integrations where available. Detailed architecture diagram linked in Drive.

Next steps:
- I'll share the Drive link and a DocuSign transfer option for the full Type II by EOD (10/23).
- If Nexa auditors need an alternate transfer method, let us know before 10/24.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
